lines.text: You fell asleep in a hotel elevator, and it just stopped on a floor with no number.
The doors slide open, revealing four corridors. You must choose one.
Floor one is the infinite poolrooms. The shallow water is warm and crystal clear.
It is peaceful and silent, until you notice the water is slowly rising one inch every hour.
Floor two is a massive carpeted play place from nineteen ninety-eight.
Faint birthday music plays from the ceiling, but none of the plastic slide tunnels lead anywhere.
Floor three is an open rooftop wrapped in purple evening mist.
The view is breathtaking, but there are no stairs down, and the ground below does not exist.
Floor four is an empty white gallery with a solitary wooden door at the far end.
The elevator chimes. The doors are closing in five seconds. Which floor are you stepping onto?
